en: Hillel the Elder sitting patiently with a non-Jewish man in simple foreign clothes, pointing at large Hebrew-looking letter shapes on a wooden tablet (shapes only, not readable text); warm study hall light.
The next day: the man looking confused and surprised as Hillel smiles and points at the same tablet now turned around; a lesson about trusting the teacher.

en: Two messengers on horseback riding from a grand stone palace (Rabban Gamliel's house) toward a small poor village in the Galilee hills.

en: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, a poor humble sage, praying alone in a tiny rooftop attic, a soft ray of golden light falling on him.

ctx: רבן גמליאל ורבי חנינא בן דוסא: סוד התפילה בעליית הגג
en: Rabbi Chanina coming down a ladder with a radiant calm face, telling the two waiting messengers 'Go, the fever has left him'; one messenger noting the time by the sun's position.

en: Jerusalem of the Second Temple period at golden hour, crowded festive streets, the Temple walls in the distance (no domes).

ctx: קמצא ובר קמצא: סיפור האזהרה וסוד אהבת החינם
en: A lavish feast hall full of men in fine clothes, sages among the guests; a nervous guest (Bar Kamtza) sitting quietly at the edge of the long table.

ctx: קמצא ובר קמצא: סיפור האזהרה וסוד אהבת החינם
en: The angry host pulling Bar Kamtza up from his seat and pointing to the door, while the sages at the table remain silent; tense, but not violent.

ctx: קמצא ובר קמצא: סיפור האזהרה וסוד אהבת החינם
en: Bar Kamtza walking away alone through a dark alley at dusk, hurt and bitter, the lights of the feast hall behind him — a warning about baseless hatred.

en: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai with his five great students around a table of scrolls in a study hall in Jerusalem.

en: A small wooden baby cradle placed in a quiet corner of a busy study hall, scholars learning loudly around it, warm light falling on the cradle (no people near the cradle).

en: Years later: young Rabbi Yehoshua, now a brilliant sage, teaching and answering questions, his teacher Rabban Yochanan looking at him proudly.
